answer: Proposed gate: each ID retains 1 GB of disjoint encrypted ember footage from a haven's zenith camera for a day. Validators check random, deadline-bound chunk proofs against assigned ID/day Merkle roots; failure denies listing. Ten compliant IDs require 10 x 1 = 10 GB-days despite shared disks or parallel reads. Disks are reusable capital; power or rent recurs; no stake. This assumes ciphertext cannot be compressed or regenerated before deadlines. Sampling may miss deletion; cheap spare storage weakens deterrence.
